title: In Antarctica, Even the Time Zone Follows the Delivery Guy
hook: At the very bottom of the Earth, the South Pole station's clocks are set to New Zealand time
summary: The South Pole station runs on New Zealand time, because that's where its supplies are sent from.

text: The very bottom of the Earth: the South Pole.
Every line of longitude meets at this one point.
Time zones are divided up by longitude.
So what time is it where all the lines of longitude meet?
The South Pole is home to America's Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station.
This station uses New Zealand time.
That's because the base that sends it supplies
Other stations in Antarctica are similar.
They use the time of the country that claims the land
or the country that sends them supplies.
So Antarctica has lots of time zones all mixed together.

panels.text: I wish I could live on delivery time too
